note: Cookiebot integrates the hosted Cookiebot/Usercentrics consent service. All local state is the cookiebot.settings config object (cookiebot_cbid UUID, cookiebot_block_cookies, cookiebot_iab_enabled, exclude_paths, exclude_admin_theme, disabled_for_roles, etc.). The consent UI/scanning/blocking run on Cookiebot's servers, so all medium/hard cases are grounded in the LOCAL config object only, never a live call. Configure route cookiebot.admin_settings_form -> /admin/config/cookiebot; permission 'administer cookiebot settings'. Introspection reads config back; execution writes config and is verified against the live cookiebot.settings.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site using the cookiebot module, what single value must I configure for the Cookiebot consent banner to start loading, what is it called, and roughly what format does it take?
evals.expected_output: You must set the Cookiebot Domain Group ID (CBID) in cookiebot.settings.cookiebot_cbid at /admin/config/cookiebot. It is a UUID like 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 (validated by regex). Until it is set the module injects nothing.

evals.prompt: The cookiebot module can automatically block cookies until a visitor consents. Which config setting controls that and what does it change in the injected Cookiebot script tag?
evals.expected_output: cookiebot_block_cookies (default true) adds data-blockingmode="auto" to the https://consent.cookiebot.com/uc.js script tag, enabling Cookiebot's automatic cookie blocking until consent.

evals.prompt: With the cookiebot module, how can I stop the consent banner from appearing on admin pages or for specific user roles?
evals.expected_output: Use exclude_admin_theme (skip admin routes), disabled_for_roles (a sequence of role IDs Cookiebot is not loaded for), and/or exclude_paths (newline path patterns with * wildcard). All live in cookiebot.settings.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site already has cookiebot configured. Inspect the live cookiebot.settings and tell me the configured Cookiebot Domain Group ID (CBID) and whether the banner is suppressed on admin pages.
evals.expected_output: cookiebot_cbid is abcdabcd-1234-5678-9abc-abcdef012345 and exclude_admin_theme is true (admin pages are excluded). Read via `drush cget cookiebot.settings`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the cookiebot module has been configured to not load for one or more user roles. Inspect the live configuration and state which role(s) have Cookiebot disabled.
evals.expected_output: disabled_for_roles contains 'anonymous' in cookiebot.settings, so Cookiebot is not loaded for anonymous users. (IAB is also enabled in this setup.)

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the cookiebot module to use the Cookiebot Domain Group ID (CBID) 11112222-3333-4444-5555-666677778888. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set cookiebot.settings.cookiebot_cbid to 11112222-3333-4444-5555-666677778888 (e.g. `drush cset cookiebot.settings cookiebot_cbid '11112222-3333-4444-5555-666677778888' -y` or via the form at /admin/config/cookiebot).

evals.prompt: Using the cookiebot module, make sure the cookie consent banner does NOT appear on the Drupal admin pages, and also does not appear on any page under /blog/. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In cookiebot.settings set exclude_admin_theme to true and add /blog/* to exclude_paths (one path per line, * wildcard).
